The Problem

Your Practice Is a Target.
You Just Don't Know It Yet.

Cybercriminals specifically target professional services — law firms, dental offices, and accounting practices — because they hold high-value data and often lack dedicated IT security.

⚖️

Law Firms

Client communications, case files, trust accounts, and M&A details are goldmines for ransomware operators and corporate espionage. One breach ends careers and triggers Law Society notifications.

🦷

Dental Practices

Patient health records, insurance data, and payment information are PIPEDA-regulated. A single exposed database means mandatory breach reporting, fines, and destroyed patient trust.

📊

Accounting Firms

Tax records, SIN numbers, corporate financials — attackers know your client portal is worth more than a bank. CRA fraud and identity theft follow within hours of a successful breach.
